verdict.rationale: Quo documents a REST API with API-key auth, JSON responses and rate limits, plus a public MCP server. None of the evidence mentions an official SDK or client library in any language, and the OpenAPI probes returned 404. A raw HTTP API and an MCP server are adjacent capabilities, not official SDKs, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
